purpose: Identity and charging boundaries, not a statement that a fare is verified or wired into V3.
invariant: One exact directed matrix fare per detected product and boundary pair. Sum distinct complete products once; any missing, ambiguous or overlapping product makes the whole toll total unknown.

products.boundary: First and last proven M-4 payment points on the selected route
products.overlap: Exclude A-289 and western Krasnodar bypass from this fare; reject mixed row.

products.boundary: First and last proven A-289 payment frames on the selected route
products.overlap: Charge separately from M-4; one A-289 product despite multiple frames.

products.boundary: Proven traversal of the far western Krasnodar bypass
products.matrix: Separate bypass tariff row; exact entry/exit binding still to audit
products.overlap: Do not include the bypass in M-4 or A-289 fare; ambiguous geography is unknown.

products.boundary: Concession entrance and exit within 15–58 km
products.overlap: Separate from M-11 58–679; do not include this head in the mainline row.

products.boundary: Mainline entrance and exit within 58–679 km
products.overlap: Exclude concession head and 679–684 tail.

products.boundary: Proven entrance and exit of 679–684 km continuation
products.overlap: Never treat a 58–679 amount as complete when this continuation is detected.

products.boundary: First and last proven M-12 payment points
products.overlap: Do not silently extend a known row to an unbound continuation.

products.boundary: First and last proven A-113 CKAD payment points
products.overlap: Intersection road names are junction metadata, not a second traversal.

products.boundary: Proven M-1 33–66 km section endpoints
products.overlap: Independent from connected roads.

products.boundary: First and last proven payment boundaries within an operator-priced M-3 product
products.matrix: M-3 directed section pair; product grouping to audit
products.overlap: Adjacent operator sections cannot be summed as intermediate gates if one OD row covers them.

products.boundary: Proven eastern Ufa exit entry and exit
products.matrix: Operator complex fare pair to audit
products.overlap: Separate from M-12; do not infer from nearby route.

products.boundary: Proven bypass/bridge entry and exit
products.matrix: Tolyatti directed tariff pair to audit
products.overlap: Separate from M-12 and regional road labels.

products.boundary: Proven northern Odintsovo bypass entry and exit

products.boundary: Proven Bagration passage
